**Depends on #62326; review only the last commit.**

## Overview

Part 2 of 3 of keeping the loaded parameter objects through `process_weights_after_loading` (PWAL). With #62326, `replace_parameter` keeps the registered object. This PR converts the PWAL sites that still register a fresh `torch.nn.Parameter` over a loaded one to `replace_parameter`.

## Claims

- `layer.x = Parameter(...)`, `setattr(layer, x, Parameter(...))` and no-op rewraps (`Parameter(layer.x.data)`) in PWAL now go through `replace_parameter`, so the loaded object (class, `weight_loader`, dim attributes) survives. This covers:
  - linear kernels: MXFP4, MXFP6, MXFP8, NVFP4 (CUTLASS, FlashInfer, FBGEMM, PyTorch, Humming scales), mixed precision (ExLlama, RDNA3, XPU);
  - compressed-tensors, Quark, INC, FBGEMM FP8, ModelOpt, AutoAWQ and online lm_head methods, and Marlin FP4 helpers;
  - `dispatch_cpu_unquantized_gemm`, CPU AMX MLA, and DeepSeek-V4 CPU attention.
- Coverage (whole-tree enumeration of PWAL-reachable sites on `main`, 1786 rows split across the three PRs): 141 sites converted here, plus 2 n/a rows inside the changed hunks. Deletes and renames in the same functions are left as on `main`; they are in the follow-up PR.

## Validation

- `pre-commit` passes.
- On GB200, `tests/quantization/test_keep_param_objects.py` and `tests/model_executor/test_utils.py` pass: 23 passed. This PR adds the `modelopt-fp8-pb-wo-linear` and `modelopt-mxfp8-linear` cases, which fail on #62326 alone.
- The end-to-end GB200 run is described in #62326. It compares `main`, #62326, and the top of the stack, which includes this PR. The rows that touch this PR's sites are below.

  | Config | GSM8K main / stack | Post-PWAL tensors |
  |---|---|---|
  | MiniMax-M3 MXFP8 (ModelOpt MXFP8 linear), TP4 | 0.859 / 0.859 | identical |
  | compressed-tensors W8A8 FP8 per-tensor + FP8 KV cache | 0.738 / 0.738 | identical |
  | same, Humming forced (reads `processed_weight_dims`) | 0.751 / 0.758 | identical |
  | same, Marlin forced | 0.738 / 0.734 | identical |

  - The same kernels are selected in both arms.
  - Every loader-visible param is the same object after PWAL; on `main`, 10% are for W8A8 FP8 and 49% for M3.

## Details

- Compressed-tensors W8A8 FP8 and ModelOpt FP8 per-tensor transpose the weight to (K, N). The kept param keeps its checkpoint dim tags, and the layout reaches Humming via `layer.processed_weight_dims` (added in #62326) instead of a retag.
- Where a site re-creates a param whose shape or dtype changes, `replace_parameter` rebinds `.data`; where the layout matches, it copies into the existing storage.
- `modelopt.py`, `quark_nvfp4.py`, `fbgemm_fp8.py`, `inc_wna16_linear.py` and `kernels/linear/nvfp4/humming.py` also delete or rename params. Only their `Parameter(...)` assignments are converted here.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""PWAL keeps the parameter objects (class and loader attributes) it converts."""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config.model import ModelConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import FusedMoEFactory
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ReplicatedLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.base_config import QuantizationConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8Config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.modelopt import (
+    ModelOptFp8Config,
+    ModelOptMxFp8Config,
+    ModelOptNvFp4Config,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.mxfp4 import Mxfp4Config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online.mxfp4 import (
+    Mxfp4OnlineLinearMethod,
+    Mxfp4OnlineMoEMethod,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.reload.meta import materialize_meta_tensor
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import default_weight_loader
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+    reason="NVFP4/MXFP8 cases select the converted kernels on SM100.",
+)
+
+SIZE = 512
+
+
+def _load(layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Stand in for the weight loader: materialize and fill with finite values."""
+    for name, param in list(layer.named_parameters(recurse=False)):
+        if param.is_meta:
+            param = materialize_meta_tensor(param)
+            setattr(layer, name, param)
+        if param.dtype == torch.uint8:  # packed FP4 values or E8M0 scales
+            param.data.copy_(torch.randint(120, 130, param.shape))
+        elif param.dtype.is_floating_point:
+            param.data.copy_(torch.rand(param.shape) + 0.5)
+
+
+def _dims(param: torch.Tensor) -> tuple:
+    return tuple(
+        getattr(param, k, None) for k in ("input_dim", "output_dim", "packed_dim")
+    )
+
+
+def _linear(quant_config: QuantizationConfig, output_size: int = SIZE):
+    layer = ReplicatedLinear(SIZE, output_size, bias=False, quant_config=quant_config)
+    return layer, layer.quant_method
+
+
+def _online_linear():
+    layer = torch.nn.Module()
+    layer.input_size = layer.input_size_per_partition = SIZE
+    layer.output_size = layer.output_size_per_partition = SIZE
+    layer.params_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    method = Mxfp4OnlineLinearMethod()
+    method.create_weights(
+        layer,
+        input_size_per_partition=SIZE,
+        output_partition_sizes=[SIZE],
+        input_size=SIZE,
+        output_size=SIZE,
+        params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        weight_loader=default_weight_loader,
+    )
+    return layer, method
+
+
+def _moe(quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None):
+    layer = FusedMoEFactory(
+        num_experts=8,
+        top_k=2,
+        hidden_size=SIZE,
+        intermediate_size=SIZE,
+        params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        quant_config=quant_config,
+        prefix="model.layers.0.mlp.experts",
+    ).routed_experts
+    return layer, layer.quant_method
+
+
+def _online_moe():
+    layer, _ = _moe(None)
+    method = Mxfp4OnlineMoEMethod(moe=layer.moe_config)
+    method.create_weights(
+        layer=layer,
+        num_experts=8,
+        hidden_size=SIZE,
+        intermediate_size_per_partition=SIZE,
+        params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        weight_loader=layer.weight_loader,
+    )
+    return layer, method
+
+
+NVFP4 = dict(is_checkpoint_nvfp4_serialized=True, kv_cache_quant_algo=None)
+
+CASES: list[Callable] = [
+    lambda: _linear(Fp8Config(weight_block_size=[128, 128])),
+    # A partial trailing 128-block is padded in post-processing (GLM-style).
+    lambda: _linear(
+        ModelOptFp8Config(
+            quant_method="FP8_PB_WO",
+            is_checkpoint_fp8_serialized=True,
+            kv_cache_quant_method=None,
+            exclude_modules=[],
+        ),
+        output_size=SIZE + 64,
+    ),
+    lambda: _linear(ModelOptMxFp8Config.from_config({"quant_method": "mxfp8"})),
+    _online_linear,
+    lambda: _moe(None),
+    lambda: _moe(Fp8Config(weight_block_size=[128, 128])),
+    lambda: _moe(ModelOptMxFp8Config.from_config({"quant_method": "mxfp8"})),
+    lambda: _moe(ModelOptNvFp4Config(**NVFP4, exclude_modules=[])),
+    lambda: _moe(Mxfp4Config()),
+    _online_moe,
+]
+IDS = [
+    "fp8-block-linear",
+    "modelopt-fp8-pb-wo-linear",
+    "modelopt-mxfp8-linear",
+    "online-mxfp4-linear",
+    "unquantized-moe",
+    "fp8-block-moe",
